{{Quote|You have to get to the power control room and turn off the security seal!|Chancellor Palpatine to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] during the Senate hostage crisis|audio=PowerControlRoom.flac|<ref name="Hostage Crisis">{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}}</ref>}}
The '''power control room''' was the operations center for the control and distribution of power to both the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] and [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==History==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane's]] posse [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|infiltrated the Senate]] in order to force the release of [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] from prison. The group took over the power control room, leaving [[Robonino/Legends|Robonino]] to override the system. He succeeded in cutting primary power, sealing off both buildings.

At the time of the take over, the room was occupied by a [[D-0T|blue protocol droid]], a [[R5-S9/Legends|blue R5 astromech droid]], a [[WED-15 Treadwell droid/Legends|WED-15 Treadwell]] and an [[LEP servant droid/Legends|LEP servant droid]]. All were destroyed by one of Bane's [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|IG-86 sentinel droids]].
